lines: {target}? Black stone and lava leave little mercy. I would help whoever is closest.
If anyone heads for Basalt Deltas, tell them: Step like every block wants an argument. I will be at the square.
Ash and basalt make the Nether feel broken twice. I will keep that in mind by the square.
Basalt Deltas is no small story. A village survives by hands, not titles.
I will remember Basalt Deltas as as jagged black country with heat in its cracks. I will keep my hands free to help.
